networks.name: spare_hours
networks.description: See whether a contest entry or side project fits the free hours in your week, and ask Deadline Desk what is open.
sample_queries: I have 11 free hours a week. Could I finish a hackathon project that is due in six weeks?
Ask Deadline Desk which hackathons that allow generative AI close in the next eight weeks, and tell me which ones fit my week.
Make my Saturdays 5 hours and my Wednesdays 0.
Add an essay prize entry due in four weeks, and tell me if everything still fits.
Can you put these in my Google Calendar and remind me?

peer_policy.note: Local agents and page-local actions, plus the partner site in allowed_peers, Deadline Desk, which is called only after the visitor agrees on a consent card. Other agent sites may call this network; its bridge shares one public calculator with them.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
